definition: The angle between the horizontal and the line of sight up to an object above the observer.

The angle between the horizontal (not the vertical) and the line of sight down to an object below the observer; over horizontal ground it equals the angle of elevation from the object back to the observer.
A direction given as the angle measured clockwise from north, written with three figures before any decimal point, such as $045^{\circ}$ for north-east.
